raw_text: India Today Fact Check has verified that the viral MoD circular on troop mobilization is a fabricated document. Error Level Analysis of the photograph reveals pixel-level manipulation around the signature block and official stamp. The letterhead design was discontinued in 2022, and the file numbering format does not match MoD conventions. Defence Ministry spokesperson confirmed no such order was issued.
clean_text: India Today Fact Check confirmed MoD circular is fabricated. Error Level Analysis shows pixel manipulation around signature block. Outdated letterhead and incorrect file numbering format.
